en.title: Kingdom Hearts Skins Finally Arrive in Fortnite September 17
en.summary: The iconic worlds of Kingdom Hearts and Fortnite are colliding, with beloved characters set to appear in Epic Games' battle royale. Get ready to wield the Keyblade in a whole new arena.
en.body:
Get ready to summon your inner hero, because **Kingdom Hearts** is officially making its grand entrance into **Fortnite**! After much anticipation, Epic Games has confirmed that **Sora**, the legendary Keyblade wielder, will be dropping into the battle royale on **September 17, 2026**. But he won't be alone; **Riku**, **Kairi**, and **Roxas** are also joining the fray, bringing their distinct styles from the beloved Square Enix franchise.

Sora, Riku, and Kairi will be donning their iconic **Kingdom Hearts 2** outfits, instantly recognizable to long-time fans of the series. Meanwhile, Roxas will make his appearance in his distinctive Organization XIII coat, a nod to his pivotal role in the saga. This collaboration is part of Fortnite's Chapter Seven, Season Four: Override, promising a fresh wave of content for players. While specific bundle details and pricing are still under wraps, the arrival of these four beloved characters marks a significant moment for both gaming communities. The inclusion of a **Kingdom Key Mythic item** further deepens the integration, allowing players to wield a piece of Kingdom Hearts' magic directly in Fortnite matches.

## A Dream Come True for Fans

The excitement surrounding this **Kingdom Hearts** and **Fortnite** crossover is palpable within the gaming community. For years, players have speculated and hoped for this very collaboration, and its confirmation has sent ripples of enthusiasm across social media and fan forums. Dataminers have been buzzing with leaks, and now official teasers from Epic Games have solidified the release date, turning speculation into reality. This isn't just about adding new skins; it's about bridging two massive gaming universes and allowing fans to live out their wildest crossover fantasies. Seeing characters from a narrative-driven RPG like Kingdom Hearts interact within the sandbox chaos of Fortnite offers a unique appeal that resonates with both hardcore fans of the franchise and the broader Fortnite player base.

## What's Next

With the official release date of **September 17, 2026**, set in stone, players can expect the **Kingdom Hearts** skins and the **Kingdom Key Mythic** to become available in the **Fortnite Shop** at any time on that day. Epic Games has yet to reveal the exact cost of individual skins or any potential bundles, so players will need to keep an eye on official announcements for those details.

content_raw: Kingdom Hearts is getting its Fortnite crossover on Sept. 17, and Sora is coming along with Riku, Kairi, and Roxas. Sora, Riku, and Kairi are wearing their Kingdom Hearts 2 outfits, while Roxas is wearing his Organization XIII coat.  These skins are coming to the Fortnite Shop as part of Chapter Seven, Season Four: Override. Epic Games hasn’t posted individual prices or bundle details yet, so the total cost to buy Sora, Riku, Kairi, and Roxas is still unknown.
